messages.subject: Memory limits on glimmer
parts:
Hi everyone -

We've added memory limits on Glimmer: each process is now limited to 2GB of memory, so that a runaway process can't eat up all the system resources. If you have an app that requires more memory, please send me an email about it.

-Winston

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: Memory limits on glimmer
parts:
If you're comfortable with a unix command line, you could us the `ps` command to find out how much memory a process is using.

From inside R, you can run gc(). See the 2nd and 3rd column here ("used" and "(Mb)":

> gc()
         used (Mb) gc trigger (Mb) max used (Mb)
Ncells 172178  9.2     350000 18.7   350000 18.7
Vcells 274326  2.1     905753  7.0   867589  6.7
> x <- 1:1e7
> gc()
          used (Mb) gc trigger (Mb) max used (Mb)
Ncells  172184  9.2     350000 18.7   350000 18.7
Vcells 5274338 40.3    6152377 47.0  5274360 40.3
> rm(x)
> gc()
         used (Mb) gc trigger (Mb) max used (Mb)
Ncells 172355  9.3     350000 18.7   350000 18.7
Vcells 274618  2.1    4921901 37.6  5276499 40.3


So in this case, allocating a vector with 10 million elements takes about 40 MB.

-Winston
